title: Crest of Artorias
snippet:
Crest of Artorias -  Dark Souls - item - description 
 description : This crest opens a door in the Darkroot Garden sealed by ancient magic.

The door leads to the grave of Sir Artorias the Abysswalker. Many adventurers have left for the grave,but none have returned, for they make easy prey for local bandits. With such dangers, the crest can do more harm than good in the hands of the uninitiated.

title: Crest of Artorias
snippet:
Crest of Artorias -  Dark Souls - item - general_information 
 general_information : It is used to open the magical door in Darkroot Garden that leads to the Forest Hunter Covenant and the Great Grey Wolf Sif. Though an impression for the crest resides on both sides of the door, unlocking of the door can only be accomplished from the Darkroot Garden side and not the Forest Hunter Covenant side.

title: Crest of Artorias
snippet:
Crest of Artorias -  Dark Souls - item - trivia 
 trivia : The in-game description of the Crest of Artorias gives some hints about what lies behind the magical door in Darkroot Garden. The local bandits refer to the Forest Hunter Covenant members that attack the player when they go through the magical door. The uninitiated refers to people who are not part of the Forest Hunter covenant because if the player joins the covenant, the bandits will not attack anymore.

title: Covenant of Artorias
snippet:
Covenant of Artorias -  Dark Souls - ring - general_information 
 general_information : Covenant of Artorias allows the player to reach the Abyss. As such, it is necessary in order to reach the Four Kings boss battle. Without wearing the ring, it is impossible to survive the fall into the Abyss. Taking off the ring during the fight with the Four Kings will cause the player to be devoured by the Abyss. Other than this, the ring has no other purpose.

The Covenant of Artorias is one of the very few rings that do not carry over to NG+; players are required to kill Great Grey Wolf Sif every playthrough to obtain the ring and beat the game. This ring, when dropped, will end up in the chest behind Kingseeker Frampt after the player has quit and reloaded the game. However, in the remaster, it will automatically be in the player’s inventory.

title: Knight Artorias
snippet:
Knight Artorias -  Dark Souls III - boss - attacks 
 attacks : {'name': 'Wrath of the Abyss', 'description': "Activates in intervals after approximately 20% of his total health is reduced. After rolling away, he will slowly build up dark magic energy, presenting ample time for retaliation, potentially staggering him, or to apply augmentations to one's weapon or self. A single Sunlight Spear can stagger him and prevent this build up from finalizing. If the player does not stagger him, he will release an explosion that does magic damage in a mid-ranged area of effect all around him. Artorias' attack speed, area of effect and damage are enhanced for a limited time afterwards. These effects can stack.\n\nIn addition to the health thresholds, this attack has a time interval between uses, in that if Artorias is left undamaged for a period of time, he will re-activate Wrath of the Abyss."}

title: Knight Artorias
snippet:
Knight Artorias -  Dark Souls III - boss - trivia 
 trivia : Artorias's introduction cinematic is similar to that of the Penetrator in *Demon's Souls*, who impales a Fat Official and then tosses its corpse at the player.
Great Grey Wolf Sif wields the Greatsword of Artorias in the fight against the Chosen Undead.
Unusually for bosses, Artorias does not drop any form of Humanity. Other bosses that do not drop Humanity are Gwyndolin and Gwyn.
As *Berserk* happened to be among the favorite mangas of Hidetaka Miyazaki (the director of the *Dark Souls* franchise) and that he even approved how Catarina Set being based on Bazuso's armor, it's no surprise there are allusions to the aforementioned manga series in the game series proper. In Knight Artorias' case, he may very well influenced by Guts the Black Swordsman;

snippet:
Soul of Artorias -  Dark Souls - item - general_information 
 general_information : The Soul of Artorias can be ascended with a +10 straight sword (other than the Broken Straight Sword or Straight Sword Hilt), greatsword or ultra greatsword to create the Abyss Greatsword. It can also be given to Lord's Blade Ciaran in return for the Gold Tracer and the Dark Silver Tracer, although these weapons can also be obtained by killing her without giving her the Soul of Artorias.

The Soul of Artorias may be consumed for 16,000 souls. Feeding it to Frampt grants 10,000 souls.

title: Darkroot Garden
snippet:
Darkroot Garden -  Dark Souls - location - darkroot_forest 
 darkroot_forest : The area beyond the sealed door, requiring the Crest of Artorias is often referred to as "Darkroot Forest", or "PvP Forest" by the *Dark Souls* community, for its high amount of Player versus Player combat.

The forest contains more dangerous enemies than other parts of the area and holds the gate to the area's boss, Great Grey Wolf Sif.
One side of the forest is also home to character members of the Forest Hunter covenant, including the covenant's leader, Alvina of the Darkroot Wood.

title: Great Grey Wolf Sif
snippet:
Great Grey Wolf Sif -  Dark Souls - boss - artorias_of_the_abyss 
 artorias_of_the_abyss : Sif makes an appearance in the *Artorias of The Abyss* DLC. The player finds the wolf located behind an Illusory Wall after being led about by Alvina in the Chasm of the Abyss. Sif is found protected by a magical barrier, which was created by Artorias using his Greatshield in order to shield the wolf from the corruption of the Abyss. Upon reaching Sif after defeating the Humanity Phantoms, Sif will vanish and leave behind Artorias' shield. Sif can be summoned during the battle against Manus, Father of the Abyss, after being rescued by the player.

title: Abyss
snippet: Knight Artorias famously traversed New Londo's Abyss and hunted the Darkwraiths therein. He was protected by the power of a magical ring, which he gained after making a covenant with the beasts there. The ring prevented him from being swallowed by the void, but it led to his sword becoming cursed. In recognition of his actions, he was awarded one of Anor Londo's treasures, a Silver Pendant that allowed him to repel Dark sorceries; eventually he traveled to Oolacile to combat the threat of Manus, the lord of the Abyss. He ultimately failed in his mission he was overtaken by the dark, leaving behind his companion Sif.

title: Darkwraith (covenant)
snippet:
Darkwraith (covenant) -  Dark Souls - mechanic - how_to_join 
 how_to_join : Accessing the Darkwraith covenant requires a few more steps than the others, as one must be able to speak with Kaathe. In order to access Kaathe, the Covenant of Artorias ring is required (obtained from killing the Great Grey Wolf Sif), as well as the Key to the Seal (obtained from Ingward) and defeating the Four Kings.

After defeating the Four Kings, Kaathe should appear if the player has not placed the Lordvessel for Frampt. Answering "Yes" to his question will make him transport the player to the Firelink Altar. Speaking to him again in the Abyss, after this event, will allow the player to join the Darkwraiths.

snippet:
Abyss -  Dark Souls - location - trivia

**This likely means that Wolnir was very much alive when he fell, which explains how he was able to teach grave wardens his pyromancy, though what exactly it really was that actually caused his death is uncertain.

snippet:

It can also grant a flat bonus to the Poison buildup stat on poison weapons when worn. The bonus granted from these items can vary depending on what type of poison weapon is equipped, be it innate, infused or both:

title: Forest Hunter
snippet:
Forest Hunter -  Dark Souls - mechanic - requirements 
 requirements : The player must not have attacked Alvina.

In order to open the door leading to Alvina, players must obtain the Crest of Artorias. It is sold by Andre of Astora in Undead Parish. It is also possible to reach the covenant without opening the door, but the alternative route takes significantly more time to traverse and has far more enemies in the way.

title: Oolacile
snippet:
Oolacile -  Dark Souls - location - artorias_of_the_abyss 
 artorias_of_the_abyss : In *Dark Souls: Prepare to Die Edition* or *Artorias of the Abyss* DLC, the Chosen Undead passes through part of Oolacile after traveling into the past; however, despite it taking place centuries before the rest of the game, the Oolacile Township is still fraught with hopelessness. The township has become filled with enemies (specifically Bloatheads, Bloathead Sorcerers, and a Chained Prisoner) as the Abyss spreads, and is seemingly deserted.

One of the Four Knights of Gwyn, Artorias the Abysswalker, arrived in Oolacile to rescue Dusk of Oolacile from Manus, Father of the Abyss, but fell victim to the Abyss. By the time the Chosen Undead found him, Artorias was hostile and engaged them in combat. After the Chosen Undead defeated the brave knight, they finish what Artorias had started, continuing through Oolacile Township and onward, eventually defeating Manus and rescuing Dusk.

Dragon Remnants -  Dark Souls II - mechanic - how_to_join

title: Ring of Displacement
snippet:
Ring of Displacement -  Dark Souls - ring - overview 
 overview : As the description states, the Ring of Displacement was intended to prevent the wearer from taking damage. However, in order to balance this, it had a fixed chance of breaking whilst it was worn. As it was removed from the game before release, it is unknown how the player would have obtained it normally.

title: Knight
snippet:
Knight -  Dark Souls - mechanic - lead 
 lead : The **Knight** is one of the Classes in *Dark Souls*.

The Knight is a tank class, and starts with the highest vitality value of all classes, as well as possessing the most robust equipment. This, however, comes at the price of slower movement - although the player can remove their helmet and gauntlets to allow them to medium roll at the start of the game without much defense loss. Due to their high Strength and Dexterity levels, Knights are able to easily equip most forms of weaponry, and their faith stat is high enough as to allow for Knights healing themselves with miracles.

The Knight automatically begins the game in the Way of White covenant, but unlike the Cleric class, does not have access to the early-game miracles (unless they are bought from Petrus of Thorolund).

title: Ring of Blind Ghosts
snippet:
Ring of Blind Ghosts -  Dark Souls - ring - overview 
 overview : As the description states, the Ring of Blind Ghosts was intended to prevent the wearer from being attacked by Ghosts and Banshees in the New Londo Ruins. It was also connected to Ingward, however, as it was removed from the game before release, it is unknown how the player would have obtained it normally.

title: Brotherhood of Blood
snippet:
Brotherhood of Blood -  Dark Souls II - mechanic - how_to_join 
 how_to_join : Talk to Titchy Gren, located in the Undead Purgatory directly after the Executioner's Chariot boss fight. Reaching him before obtaining at least one Token of Spite will have him disregard the player, so be sure to find one if you wish to join the covenant. Upon meeting the requirements and confirming your desire of bathing in blood to Titchy Gren multiple times, players will be awarded the Crest of Blood.

title: Unknown Talisman
snippet:
Unknown Talisman -  Dark Souls - weapon - overview 
 overview : It was cut from the final release of the game, it is unknown how the player would have obtained it.

Due to its nature as cut content, the Unknown Talisman is simply a texture in the game files. This means that even if the player modified their save file to obtain it, it would have no stats.

title: Ashen Mist Heart
snippet:
Ashen Mist Heart -  Dark Souls II - shield - usage 
 usage : The locations for the memories are as follows:
Memory of Vammar: Located near the area that the player first meets Mild-Mannered Pate.
Memory of Orro: The giant tree is located directly after the area where the player fights The Pursuer as an actual boss.
Memory of Jeigh: Located next to The Place Unbeknownst bonfire, which requires the King's Ring to access. The Giant Lord is also fought here.
Dragon Memories: The crystal the player must examine is located directly underneath the dead ancient dragon in the area that the player fights The Duke's Dear Freja in Brightstone Cove Tseldora. In it, the player is transported to what is presumably the Unformed World, where they encounter the corpse of an Ancient Dragon and retrieve the Ancient Dragon Soul.
Memory of the King: Located in the Undead Crypt near King Vendrick's discarded clothing. *Crown of the Sunken King* is required to access it.
